rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a good quality or merit in something or someone.

example.english: The goodness of this phone is that you can use it all day.
example.traditional: 呢部手機嘅優點係可以用足一日。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 jau1 dim2 hai6 ho2 ji5 jung6 zuk1 jat1 jat6

rows.note: Use this colloquial euphemism when referring to God as a higher power in an exclamation or appeal.

example.english: Goodness, please let me win the lottery just once!
example.traditional: 老天爺，求吓你畀我中一次六合彩啦！
example.jyutping: lou5 tin1 je4 kau4 haa5 nei5 bei2 ngo5 zung3 jat1 ci3 luk6 hap6 coi2 laa1

rows.note: Use this for the nutritious, beneficial, or best part extracted from food or another substance.

example.english: This propolis extract is packed with goodness for your throat.
example.traditional: 呢樽蜂膠精華對喉嚨好有益。
example.jyutping: ni1 zeon1 fung1 gaau1 zing1 waa4 deoi3 hau4 lung4 hou2 jau5 jik1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a person's moral character and virtues.

example.english: Their grades are decent, but goodness of character matters more.
example.traditional: 佢成績唔錯，但品德更加重要。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sing4 zik1 m4 co3 daan6 ban2 dak1 gang3 gaa1 zung6 jiu3
